description: BTS Open Data Site is a data resource listed in Urban and Regional Planning Resources (APA Technology Division), a curated directory of planning data, software and learning resources under the section "Public Data Resources > Transportation", published or maintained by as named on data-usdot.opendata.arcgis.com. On the BTS Open Data site, browse geospatial data that is part of the BTS National Transportation Atlas Database (NTAD) product. Coverage: the United States. The list files it under "Public Data Resources > Transportation". The entry links to data-usdot.opendata.arcgis.com. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport and planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-apa-urban-regional-planning-resources-list.
